descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S06 Day rule table: status x day set x context -> status after the roll, plus the chart cell (yesterday's New Admission opened)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 New Admission and Consult both roll to Follow-up on the next calendar day without the physician touching them; a status set today stays today (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 4)
  • U7 A status already changed by hand before the day rolls is not affected by the roll (step 5) (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 4)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Rows seeded through the API with encType/encTypeDay (Hospital and Nursing Home); one Hospital patient seeded New Admission with yesterday's day and opened in the chart (former S08)

When Run the lifecycle with today's day; open the seeded chart

Then New Admission and Consult set on an earlier day -> Follow-up (day restarts); set today -> unchanged; Follow-up -> untouched; a hand set restarts the clock; a set without a day clears the old day; yesterday's New Admission reads Follow-up in the chart, SOAP progress is pre-selected, and the row is saved as Follow-up with today's day

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions on rounding:list / snf:list after rounding:applyLifecycle / snf:applyLifecycle, and expectStatus follow-up / Note Format soap in the chart. These pass the client's day ('yesterday' is the device day), so they prove the rule, not which clock supplies 'today' (U6 is S10, S19, S23). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions) (API (seed encType/encTypeDay, call rounding/snf applyLifecycle with today)); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).
